title: Before the Wheels
hook: You looked at this aisle twenty minutes ago.
scene: The engine's on. Gracie's on the passenger seat, still not settled. The space beside her is empty and you keep not looking at it. The aisle behind you is the way out, and the last time you saw it was before.
decision: Before you roll, what do you do?

options.text: Pull out. It was empty a minute ago.
options.result: You back out on a look you already spent. It might still be empty. You wouldn't know.

options.text: Look it again — both ways, and behind the bumper
options.result: Left, right, the row you're backing into, the ground behind you. Then you move, and the lot is clear because you checked, not because it was clear before.

options.text: Call her name once more, then go
options.result: Your voice goes out across the wet asphalt and nothing comes back, and you've spent the check on a name.

options.text: Sit with the empty seat until you're ready
options.result: You look at the seat for a while. The aisle goes unlooked-at the whole time.

debrief: Look before you move, every time. A clear lot goes stale in a minute.

source.psdp_skill: Skill one: before you start the engine
source.teaching_target: Look the aisle before she rolls. A remembered empty lot is not a look.

image_brief.camera_pose: Camera is INSIDE the cabin at the left-seat occupant's eye height, looking LEFT and slightly forward at the left door-mounted side mirror through the open left window. This is Ali's own view of her own mirror from the left seat. The camera never leaves the cabin. Not a shot of the car from outside. Not standing beside the car. Not looking in through a window or an open doorway. If the vehicle's exterior sheet metal, fender, or wheel is visible as a subject, the take is wrong.
